Commentary.Commentary: Ireland bowlers got a serious beating at the hands of the Kiwi batsmen. All their pacers were taken for runs and just couldn't stop the bleeding. Their spinners Dockrell and Singh did manage to dry up the runs in the middle overs with the latter being the standout of all as apart from him everyone suffered. So, with a huge score in front, Ireland have the task cut out. In the series we have seen them giving a fight to NZ. They would be looking to repeat the same. Can they cause an upset or will New Zealand clinch the tri-series? Let's wait and find out. Join us in a bit for the run chase, weather permitting...

A carnage is what we got to witness by New Zealand! They have racked up a humongous total on the board after being put into bat. It all started with Ronchi at the top along with the skipper and together they stitched a 70-run stand and provided a breezy start. The keeper got out early but the skipper stayed for a bit and kept on threading fruitful stands with Broom and Taylor. Latham departed immediately after scoring a ton and then it was Taylor who carried the ship forward. Towards the end it was Colin Munro who went berserk scoring a 15-ball 44 and provided the impetus that his side needed. NZ scored 76 in the last 5 overs and that helped them cross the 340-run mark.

Yorker and it's jammed straight back to the bowler as Santner looks to cross. Milne sends him back seeing the bowler getting to the ball. Now Santner and McCarthy both run towards the bowler's end and Barry dislodges the bails. No harm done as Santner was in comfortably. A dot ball to end the innings. New Zealand finish with 344/6!
FOUR! Slower one outside off, Milne stays put and slams it over extra cover for a boundary.

Fuller in length, Santner looks to have it across the line. There is a hesitation between the batsmen as the throw comes in at the bowler's end who whips the bails off but Mitchell is quick to get in safely. A single taken.
A run out appeal is referred upstairs...
Slower ball outside off stump. Milne gets an inside edge which rolls onto the ground and they run through for a single.
Wide! Bowls it a little to wide outside off stump and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Milne gets across and paddles it down to fine leg for a couple.
Milne backs away and hits it over extra cover for a couple.
Fuller in length, drilled through covers for a single. 20 from the penultimate over!
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Santner gets into the groove now! Chase pitches it up on the stumps, Santner gets under it and lifts it beautifully over the long on fence for a maximum.
Adam Milne is the new man in!

OUT! Got him! Dangerous Munro is out of here! Slower length ball around off,  Munro looks to go big down the ground but gets a top edge and it goes straight up in the air. The keeper, Nail O'Brien calls for it, he misjudges it at first but does well to take it in the end. A good innings from Munro comes to an end.
SIX! Back-to-back biggies for Munro. He's playing a gem on a innings. Full again and Munro smacks it over mid-wicket for another biggie.
SIX! Boom! Full ball on off, Munro heaves it over mid-wicket for a maximum. It's raining boundaries here.
Peter Chase is back into the attack. The drizzle has picked up. The umpires still feel it's not that threatening to take the players off.
FOUR! 21 off the over, a big one for the Kiwis! A full toss outside off, Santner slices it over Simi Singh at backward point and gets another boundary.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! That's gone the distance! Munro, you beauty! Good length delivery outside off, Munro once again goes for the reverse hit. This time gets it off the meat of the bat as the ball sails over point for a biggie.
FOUR! Impressive! A low full toss on off, Munro gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it towards fine leg for a one bounce boundary. 300 on the board for New Zealand!
FOUR! Fuller in length on off, Munro drills it along the ground through covers for a boundary.

In the air... safe! Angles in a length delivery, Munro looks to go big over the leg side but mistimes it high in the air. Ed Joyce from long leg comes running in and dives forward to take it but the ball doesn't stick. Tough chance and they pick up a double.
FOUR! Lucky there. Short ball Santner goes for the pull, gets a top edge over the keeper for a boundary. 20 runs of the over
2 runs, runs flowing here this over, gets an inside edge down past the stumps again.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! hits the ball to wide long-off, Joyce makes a mess of the ball on the boundary and it goes for another boundary. Should have done better there.
Full ball, Munro mistimes his heave down to long off for a couple. They get an overthrow and there is no backing up again.
SIX! Munro makes great contact there, full ball, Munro picks it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
WIDE! Short ball, bounces over the head off the batsman and the umpire signals wide.
Slower ball on the pads, Munro flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. A wicket and just 4 runs from it!
Full ball, Santner tries to drive it through covers but gets a thick outside edge down to third man for a run.
Low full toss, Munro drives it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Full ball, Munro dugs it out to point.
Full ball is drilled down the ground for a run.
Colin Munro is the new man in!

OUT! Bowling change does the trick for Ireland! A lucky wicket to say the least! McCarthy dishes out a waist high full toss, Ross Taylor could have hit it anywhere but he hits it straight down the throat off Simi Singh at deep backward square leg who takes a simple catch. A timely wicket for the home side.
Barry McCarthy comes on to bowl here!
Back of a length ball, Santner lets the ball go.
Mitchell Santner walks in next!
OUT! Smart bowling! Anderson chops it on! Young bowls an off cutter outside off, Anderson looks to force it through the off side but gets a thick inside edge which cannons on to the stumps.
SIX! That's a huge hit, short on his body, Anderson pulls it way over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Length ball on leg, Anderson hits it towards deep square leg where Wilson does well to dive to his right and prevent a boundary. Still two taken.
Full ball on leg stump, Anderson heaves it to deep square leg for a couple.
Young bowls a yorker, Anderson looks to swing but gets an inside edge and rolls through to the keeper.

FOUR! Taylor is toying with the field. Bowled quicker and full around middle, Taylor shuffles across and paddle sweeps it past short fine leg for a boundary. Three consecutive boundaries in that over, an expensive one for the hosts as 16 came off it.
35th ODI fifty for Ross Taylor!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Tossed up on off, Taylor backs away and lifts over extra cover for a boundary and also brings up his fifty. He's looking to up the ante here.
FOUR! Quicker, but on the shorter side. Taylor moves away and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Floats it on middle, Anderson works it on the leg side for a run.
Moves away and cuts it towards covers for a single.
Tossed up, Taylor gives himself room and hits it over extra cover for a run. No wait, they get an overthrow and they come back for a second. Sloppy from the Irishmen.
Paul Stirling comes back into the attack!
Another short ball from Young, Anderson comes down the pitch and swings hard at it only to get beaten. Just 4 from the over!
Length ball, Taylor swings it to the leg side for a run.
Bowled short, the batsman misses the pull and it goes through to the keeper.
Appeal for LBW, but not given. Full toss on leg stump, Anderson goes for a heave over mid-wicket but misses it completely. The ball goes towards the off side and they run through for a leg bye.
Hits the length, Anderson defends it off the front foot.
WIDE! Slower ball, but bowls it down the leg side and is signalled a wide.
Banged in short, Taylor pulls it to fine leg for a run.
Craig Young comes back into the attack!
Floats it on off stump, Anderson drives it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short, Anderson rocks back and punches it through covers for a couple.
Drilled down the ground for a single.
Floats it on off stump. Anderson works it to fine leg for a run.
Tossed up outside off, Taylor guides it past short third man for a run.
Simi Singh to bowl his last over!
Good ball! Very full on off, Anderson swings with all his might but could connect only the thin air.
Free Hit coming up.
No ball for height! Chase bowls it on the waist height as Taylor pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. The umpire stretches his right hand to signal it a no ball for the height.
Wide! Strays down the leg side, Taylor misses the flick.
Short on off, Anderson flat-bats it down to long on for a single.
Length delivery on leg, glanced behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller on the pads, helped down to fine leg for a brace.
Slower one, angling in on middle, Ross looks to tuck it away but the lack of pace induces a leading edge which dies down on the ground.
FOUR! That's mauled! A short ball which doesn't rise and sits up at a nice height for Taylor who stays back and pulls it firmly over mid-wicket for a boundary. Off the meat of the bat!
Peter Chase brought back into the attack.
On the pads, flicked towards backward square leg for a single.
Quicker through the air, it skids off the surface as Taylor misses on the attempted cut shot.

What was that? Taylor premeditates and goes for the paddle sweep but then sees the ball is way outside off and hence at the last moment he tries to adjust, plays the reverse paddle. The ball hits the back portion of the bat and dies down on the surface.
Darts it on the pads, flicked behind squar eon the on side for a single.
Fires it full outside off, knocked down to long off for one.
Touch short and around off, played with an angled bat towards point.
Uppish but safe! Fuller in length and outside off, Anderson takes the aerial route as he lofts it over extra cover. The ball lands in no man's land. A couple taken.
Good length and this one comes back in a shade, Anderson tries cutting it through the line but fails to get any bat on it.
A bit of width on offer, shorter in length, Taylor slaps it towards sweeper cover for just a single.
On a length and just around off, Ross pushes it away with soft hands.
Beaten! On a length and it kicks off the deck as Taylor tries slashing at it but is beaten all ends up.
Length delivery on off, punched towards covers for one.
Touch flat and around off, Anderson punches it through covers for a single. Taylor wants the second one as well but Anderson sends him back in time.
The wind is picking up pace and it's getting really dark out there.
Fuller around off, worked towards the leg side.
Pushes it a bit quicker through the air outside off, Anderson tries cutting it but ends up chopping it beside the pitch as there was no room on offer.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one outside off, Ross cuts it nicely but once again it goes towards the man at backward point.
Loopy delivery outside off, turning in as Taylor waits for the ball and dabs it towards backward point.
Simi Singh comes back to bowl.
Fuller and well outside off, Anderson is happy to let it be.
Comes from around the wicket and angles in a short ball on middle, defended towards the man at point by Corey.
Shortish outside off, tapped towards the left of the backward point fielder and sets off for a brisk single.
Touch fuller on off, pushed towards the off side.
Good length on off, Taylor taps it towards covers and looks to get to the other end. Anderson sends him back in time.
Fuller in length and around off, defended back to the bowler.
Barry McCarthy is back into the attack.
Corey Anderson strides out to the middle.

OUT! Stumped! Tom Latham departs! This is smart bowling from Dockrell! He sees Latham giving the charges and hence fires it full outside off, Latham cannot get bat to it as Niall O'Brien behind the stumps collects the ball and whips the bails off. Latham tries coming back inside the crease but is a bit too late in doing so. It's not even refereed upstairs and the Kiwi skipper starts to walk back but not before playing a superb knock.
FOUR! Lucky, very lucky! Floats it up on the stumps, Latham gets down to sweep but gets an inside edge which evades the leg stump and races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Darts it on middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single.
3rd ODI ton for Tom Latham.

There it is! A century for Tom Latham! A raise of the bat from him. Can he go on to get a daddy hundred? Floats it up around middle, Latham skips down the track and flicks it towards wide long on for a single.
Arm ball around off, defended from within the crease.
Tossed up delivery around off, driven towards mid off for a single.
George Dockrell comes back into the attack.
Time for Drinks.
FOUR! Latham moves onto 99! Too full and wide outside off, Latham transfers his weight on the front foot and drives it along the ground through extra cover for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on middle, turned towards mid on.
Shortish and angling away, Latham once again dabs it but the backward point fielder gets to the ball.
Shortish on off, dabbed towards backward point.
FOUR! What a hit! Overpitched on off, Latham just chips it over the bowler's head and picks up a boundary.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Gives it air, Taylor drives it to mid-wicket.
Dances down the track and drives it to long on for a run.
Fires it down leg side, sees the batsman coming down, Taylor adjusts and tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Short outside off, Latham cuts it to deep covers for a run.
Quicker, Taylor tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Tossed up, Taylor drives it to short mid-wicket for no runs.
Full ball, driven down the ground for a single.
FOUR! That's rubbing salt on the wound! A short ball on middle and off, Taylor swings at it. doesn't get it off the middle of the bat but had enough to hit it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Free Hit.

In the air... gone! What a catch that is by McCarthy! Wait, hang on! The umpire's are checking for the front foot. Dear! oh Dear! Young has overstepped! Ireland can't believe their luck. A length delivery on middle and leg, Latham flicks it in the air towards fine leg where Barry McCarthy sprints in and dives forward to to take it inches above the ground. They start to celebrate but the umpire asks the Kiwi skipper to wait as he checks for the front foot. Replays show Young was overstepped, Latham gets a reprieve here. Free-hit coming up.
Latham doesn't pick it up and does well to defend it to safety on the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish on middle, Taylor shuffles a bit and works it towards the right of the mid on fielder for a single.
Fuller in length and angling in, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Craig Young comes back into the attack!
Tossed up around off, Taylor milks it down to long on for a single.
Slower one around off, Taylor looks to flick by coming down but gets a safe leading edge back to Simi.
Fuller around off, bunted back to Singh.
Short and outside off, Taylor goes back and cuts it to the left of the backward point fielder.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Shuffles a touch and dinks down to long on for one.

Top edge but safe! Tosses it up around middle, Tom gets down to sweep it but gets a top edge which goes over the man at short fine leg who chases it and does well to stop it inside the rope. A brace added to the total.
Floats it up on off, driven through covers for a single.
Darts it full on off, Taylor jams it out towards short extra cover.
A bit slower through the air around off, Ross defends it down the pitch.
FOUR! Good shot! Tosses it wider outside off, Taylor reaches out to that one and drills it through covers for a boundary.
Leg bye! Steps out to flick it across the line but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards point. A leg bye taken.
Flighted ball around off, Taylor gets on the front foot but plays a mistimed drive towards extra cover.
Very full on the stumps, worked down to long on for a single.
Floated delivery outside off, Tom lunges forward and drives it towards covers.
Stays back, allows the back to turn in and then punches it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up around middle and off, Taylor comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler who does well to stop it by diving to his right.
Slower through the air outside off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Waits for the ball, Latham punches it down to long on for a run.
Quicker ball, Taylor plays it through mid-wicket for a run.
Comes down the pitch and hits it down to Balbirnie on the long off boundary, mis-fields and they come back for a second.
Tossed on a length, Taylor defends it onto the ground.
Flighted ball, swept to deep square leg for a run.
George Dockrell is back on!
Gets down the pitch and drives the ball this time past extra cover. The long off fielder mops it up as they pick up a single.
Tossed up, Latham pushes it to covers for no runs.
Short outside off, Taylor plays the square cut for a run.
Latham dances down the track and drives it long off for a run.
Floats it on off stump, Latham defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up ball, Latham uses his feet and drives it to mid-wicket.
Simi Singh comes back into the attack!
Length ball, outside off, Latham guides it down to thrid man for a run.
Clipped through backward square leg, Taylor turns quickly for the second and they get back easily.
Stays in the crease and defends the ball into the leg side again, Singh is quick to stop it at mid-wicket.
Full ball, it's driven to mid on.
Lands on a length, Latham defends the ball into the ground.
Length ball on the pads, Latham tucks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball it's defended by covering the line off the ball.
Full this time, Tom drives it through covers for a run.

SIX! Sails over this time! Chase, you cannot bowl short to this guy, he'll punish you all day log. Latham gets inside the line and just pulls it over the deep backward square leg fence for a maximum. There was a man there but he could only watch it sail over him.
Fuller in length and around off, Latham leans into it and drives it beautifully but finds the man at extra cover. Is kicking himself for not finding the gap.
FOUR! Short ball on the body of the batsman, Latham moves across and pulls it down to fine leg for a boundary. Brings up the 150 for New Zealand.
Bowled on the pads, Taylor tucks it away to square leg for a run.
Lands it on a length, Taylor plays it with soft hands on the off side for a single.
Bowls it outside off, an easy leave for Ross.
On the pads works it to fine leg for a run.
Shorter ball, stays in the crease and wafts the ball into the legside. Singh fields again.
Back of a length, played to point for no runs.
Good length delivery, angling in, worked towards the man at mid-wicket.
Barry McCarthy is back on!
Length ball outside off, it is left alone by the batsman.
Ross Taylor is the new man in!

OUT! Gone, timely wicket for Ireland! Peter Chase bowls a length ball, Broom comes down the track and tries to hit it over mid off. But much to his dismay he does not get the desired elevation and Ed Joyce stationed there leaps a bit to his left to take a simple catch. Broom is disappointed as he trudges back.
Full ball, Broom drives it to mid on for no runs.
Played to point for a run.
FOUR! Lovely wrist work, full on the pads Latham flicks it through mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary. No chance for any fielder there.
Length ball punches it off the back foot to covers for a run.
Flighted ball around off, Tom defends it down.
Drives it down to mid off for a run.
FOUR! Lovely use of the wrists! Broom comes down the track, meets the ball on the full and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quicker this time, flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Floats it up on off stump, Latham punches it down the ground towards long on. Balbirnie does well to dive and stop the ball, they run through for two.
SIX! Superb timing, great shot! Latham comes down the track to the tossed up delivery and lofts it inside out over long off for a maximum to start the over. He admires the shot himself.

Back of a length close to the off stump line, Broom waits for it and at the last moment tries dabbing it away. The ball doesn't rise and as a result he gets an inside edge to the keeper who collects it on the bounce.
Fuller and angling in, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Good length ball on middle, defended back to the bowler.
On a length and outside off, steered towards backward point.
8th ODI fifty for Tom Latham!

Fifty up for the Kiwi skipper! He's played a good hand here and looks hungry for more! fuller ball on the stumps, driven off the front foot towards mid on and scampers through for a quick single. A raise of a bat from him.
Back of a length ball, angling in from outside off, Latham wrists it to the left of the mid on fielder. He wants the single but the fielder is quick to deny him.
Peter Chase is called back into the attack!
Short, batsman punches it through covers for a couple.
Comes down the track, drives it to long on for a run.
Quick ball, angling into the stumps, Broom plays it late to short third for a run.
50-run stand is up between Broom and Latham!
Quicker ball, Latham sweeps it and gets a top edge over the keeper for a run.
Waits for the ball, late cuts it to backward point for a single.
gets onto the front foot and drives the ball through extra cover. Its in the air and just out of Porterfield's reach at extra cover
Tosses it up, batsman sweeps it for a run.
Square cuts it to point for a run.
The batsman plays a sweep shot.
Comes down the track, plays it to mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, Broom defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Poor bowling, sees the batsman charge, fires it down the leg side, the batsman just had to get bat on it and thats what he does, the ball races to the fine leg fence.
On a length, defended the ball by covering the line.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
FOUR! GREAT TIMING! Full ball, Latham gets down on one knee and sweeps it past short fine. Simi puts in a desperate dive but fails to stop the boundary.
Down the leg side, Lamtham attempts the sweep and misses it. Not called a wide.
Tossed up, Broom uses his feet and drives it to covers for a run.

A loud shout for an LBW! Dockrell sends it quicker through the air around off, it's the arm ball as Neil Broom looks to defend it with his bat close to the pad. The ball goes towards the keeper and the bowler keeps appealing. The keeper joins him as the umpire after taking his time shakes his head. From the side angle it looked like pad first but from the front angle it seemed like it's bat first. The umpire however, feels Broom has kept it out somehow.
George Dockrell is back into the attack.
Drinks are on the field!
Around middle and leg, Latham gets down to sweep it but gets beaten. Just 3 off that over!
Tosses it up outside off, Latham shimmies down the track and drives it hard towards extra cover where Porterfield dives to his right to stop it.
Slows it through the air as Latham steps out and plays it with an angled bat towards point.
Comes down the track and wrists it wide of mid on for one.
Fuller around off, worked towards long on for another single.
Tossed up around middle, driven towards long on for a single.
Paul Stirling to roll his arm over now!
On a length, Broom flicks it to square leg for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Short outside off, Latham cuts it to point for a run.
Slower ball, Broom hits it on the leg side for a run.
Bowls it on the leg stump, is flicked to fine leg for a run.
WIDE! Strays down the leg side, Latham misses the flick and it is called a wide.
On a length, defended back to the bowler.
Barry McCarthy comes back on for a bowl!
Floats it up outside off, turns in as Broom looks to work it on the leg side. Closes the bat face a bit early as the leading edge falls well short of the bowler.
Around off, it grips and turns in as Neil keeps it out off the front foot.
Floats it up around middle and off, Latham gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it past the bowler to long on for a single.
Stays back and hits it straight to the point fielder.
Short and around middle, Broom comes a step ahead and pulls it through square leg for a single.
Comes down the track and eases it towards long on for a single.
Angles the ball down to backward point, Porterfield gets to the ball quickly to cut off the run.
FOUR! Easy picking! Short on the body off the batsman, he pulls the ball to fine leg for a boundary.
Driven through mid-off by the batsman.
Back of a length outside off, Latham tries to pull it over mid-wicket, gets a top edge and has just enough to clear the infield, they run through for a single.
Length ball on the stumps, is flicked by Latham to short mid-wicket.
Full ball on middle is driven to mid on for no runs.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wide! Bowled down the leg side and called a wide.
Quicker outside off, Latham cuts it off the back foot for a run.
Uses his feet, gets to the pitch off the ball, but is driven straight to cover.
Again on the pads, flicks it to square leg for a run.
On the pads this time, is flicked to the leg side for a run.
Tosses it up, Latham drives it to cover.
FOUR! Tickled fine! Young drifts on the pads, Broom flicks it to fine leg, the fielder over runs it and lets it go for a boundary. Should have done better there.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Bowled on a length, Broom defends it off the back foot.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Big appeal for LBW, but the umpire is not interested. Fuller and angling in on the pads, Broom flicks it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Short on the body, Latham tucks it for a single to square leg.
Quicker outside off, Latham punches through covers for a run.
Short ball outside off, Latham attempts to cut but is beaten.
Floats it on the pads, Broom flicks it to square leg for a run.
Bowled outside off, Latham punches off the back foot for a run.
Tossed up on off stump, Broom drives it through covers for a run.
Simi starts off with a low full toss on the pads, Latham tickles it to short fine leg and the fielder dives to his left to make a good stop, the batsman still run through for a single.
On a length and around middle, turned through the leg side for nothing.
Simi Singh is seen warming up. Shouldn't be long before he comes into the attack...
Strays on the pads, clipped through square leg for a couple.
Another short ball on leg, Latham tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
Good length delivery on off, pushed off the front foot towards the off side.
Shortish on off, dabbed down to third man for a single. Broom is off the mark.
Neil Broom is the next man in!

OUT! Bowled 'em! Craig Young draws first blood! A much-needed one for the hosts! He hurls it on a good length and it nips back in as Ronchi tries to hit it away. Luke misses it completely and the ball goes on to disturb the woodwork behind. Ronchi walks back after providing a good start.
Craigh Young comes back into the attack!
Powerplay 2 signalled! Maximum 4 fielders are now allowed outside the circle. Can Ireland get their first breakthrough or will the Kiwis continue to march on?
Fuller in length and angling in, eased down to long on for a comfortable single.
Rolls his fingers over the ball around off, Ronchi tries cutting it but is undone by the lack of pace on it.
Fires in a yorker at the base of the stumps, Ronchi does well to keep it at bay.
Good length delivery in the line of the stumps, pushed straight to mid on.
Back of a length on off, punched off the back foot towards Stirling at covers.
Angles in a length delivery on the pads, Ronchi tries to tuck it away but wears it on the thigh pad as the ball rolls away towards mid-wicket.
Tossed it up on off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.

FOUR! Up and over! Nicely tossed up around middle and off, Latham skips down the track and flicks it uppishly over mid-wicket. A couple of bounce and into the fence she goes. Dockrell was brought into the attack to stop the bleeding but even he's been taken for aplenty.
Tom has punched the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up around middle and leg, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter around middle, punched off the back foot towards Joyce at mid on.
FOUR! Easily done! Fuller and on the pads, Latham doesn't let it go waste. Flicks it neatly through square leg and ends the over with another boundary.
Shortish on leg, Latham mistimes the pull over the square leg fielder and comes back for a brace.
Very full outside off, Latham crouches low to dig it out but fails to get any wood on it.
On the pads, clipped towards square leg.
Wide! Sprays down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone.

FOUR! Edged and away! On a length and it moves away a touch outside off, Latham looks to punch it through the off side but gets a thick outside edge which evades the first slip fielder. Andrew Balbirnie in the deep was a bit square and had no chance to stop that one.
FOUR LEG BYES! McCarthy has a wayward start here! Serves it on the pads, Latham tries helping it down to fine leg but the ball brushes his pads and goes past Nial O'Brien to the fine leg fence.
Barry McCarthy comes into the attack.
Very full around off, Ronchi makes a bit of room and drives it towards point for nothing.
Flattish around middle and off, Ronchi rocks back to pull but misses as the ball goes under his bat to the keeper.
Another short ball, it's punched towards covers where the fielder puts in a dive to his right to stop it. They look for a single but won't get it.
FOUR! That's flayed! Drops it short and it's serves quicker outside off, Ronchi pounces on it in a flash. Cuts it hard and it goes past the man at point for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Lovely! Tosses it up outside off, Ronchi moves leg side and lifts it inside out over extra cover for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, turning in a touch, Ronchi makes room and punches it towards covers.
Comes forward to this yorker and digs it out towards covers. 12 off the over!
SIX! Another biggie! Short of a length delivery on leg, Tom Latham moves inside the line and pulls it with authority over fine leg for second maximum of the over. NZ are off to a great start here.
Good length delivery on off, punched towards Stirling at cover-point. Another good stop!
Stays back and defends it with a straight blade towards covers.
SIX! What a shot that is! Short, width on offer outside off and Tom Latham is too good a player to miss out on that one. He slaps it off over point as the ball sails over the fence for a biggie.
Super stop! Fuller in length and around off, Latham drives it hard but Simi Singh at extra cover dives to his right to save a certain boundary.
Floats it up around off, punched hard but another brilliant stop in covers. A good tight over from Dockrell.
Fuller around middle, worked towards short mid-wicket where the fielder dives to stop it with one hand. The batsmen get one though.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
A slip comes in for Latham...
Short and turning away a touch, Ronchi punches it towards Stirling at point who fumbles and allows them to pick up a single.
Drops it a bit short and outside off, Luke camps back and cuts it hard but finds the fielder at point.
Tossed up delivery around middle, Ronchi off the back foot defends it back to the bowler.
George Dockrell comes on to bowl.
Good length delivery on the pads, Latham tucks it towards square leg.
Fuller and curling back in, the Kiwi skipper drives it back to the bowler.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards covers.
Good length delivery, angling away, Tom presses forward and defends it towards point.
Angles in a length ball from around off, tapped in front of point for a quick single.
FOUR! Easy picking those! Short and angling down leg, Ronchi swivels a touch and pulls it down to fine leg for a one bounce boundary. Ireland are offering too much loose balls.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

NOT OUT! Fuller in length and around middle, Luke Ronchi bunts it back to Chase who gets a hand to it and deflects it towards covers. They look to steal a quick single as Singh has a shy at the bowler's end. He hits and they appeal. It's refereed upstairs and replays show the Kiwi keeper is fine.
A run out appeal against Ronchi is refereed upstairs...
Touch fuller on off, Ronchi drives it off the front foot towards Singh at extra cover who fails to stop it with a dive. The ball rolls further and they manage to come back for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Shot, that! Back of a length delivery in the channel on off, Ronchi cuts it between cover and point for another boundary.
Serves a short ball outside off, Ronchi looks to cut but the ball kicks off the deck and he gets beaten.
Length delivery on the leg stump, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Strays on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Slightly overpitches on off, Latham drives it off the front foot towards extra cover for nothing.
Very full and wide outside off, Latham has got nothing to do with that one.
On a length and outside off, easy leave for Latham.
Fuller in length and on the stumps, driven back to the bowler who gets a hand to hit and deflects it on the stumps at his end.
From around the wicket, he angles it away, Latham shoulders his arms.
Peter Chase to bowl with the second new ball.
FOUR! More runs! Expensive start for the Irish here! Offers width and was asking for trouble, Ronchi cuts it over cover-point and finds the fence again. 12 from the first over!
Fuller on off, driven towards covers where Singh dives to stop the ball.
Angles in a length delivery, pushed towards the point fielder.
FOUR! Lovely start! Back of a length delivery outside off, Ronchi stays on the back foot and punches it through extra cover. Splits the gap and earns himself another boundary.
On a length and around off, Luke tries to fetch it from outside off but gets a bottom edge which goes on the bounce to the keeper.

FOUR! Top edge and over the slip cordon! Young starts with a short of a length ball, wide outside off, Ronchi throws the kitchen sink at it. Gets a top edge that flies over the slip cordon and races down to the third man fence for a boundary. New Zealand are away.

The players and umpires have made their way out to the middle. The New Zealand openers - Tom Latham and Luke Ronchi are set to open the batting. Craig Young to start off with the bowling proceedings. Two slips in place. Here we go...

Ireland have made 2 changes while New Zealand have made 4 changes from their previous game. For the hosts - Craig Young and Simi Singh replace Tim Murtagh and Kevin O'Brien. For the Kiwis - Corey Anderson, Adam Milne, Matt Henry and Scott Kuggeleijn come in for George Worker, Jimmy Neesham, Seth Rance, Hamish Bennett.
TOSS - IRELAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BOWL!

Hello and welcome for match 5 of the tri-series and it's the hosts who will be up against the Kiwis on what will be their last game. They are yet to register a win under their belt and let's see if they are able to cause an upset. On the oter hand, New Zealand are sitting pretty on top and another win here could see them sealing the series. They have been pretty comprehensive so far and it would be interesting to see if they make any changes or will they stick to the same combination. It's overcast at the moment but let's hope we get a full-fledged game. Stay tuned as the toss and team updates are coming your way...
